title: Gaussian torus frequency
statement: For a natural number $n$, an integer-valued assignment $m$ on $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\{0,1\}$, and $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, define the real frequency $\omega_i=2\pi\bigl(m(i,0)+\sqrt{2}\,m(i,1)\bigr)$.
